criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: Opening names Dunleavy, Austin/Data Center World Power, last October, and the $150M/1 GW claim, then a two-beat correction signal without snark, fully self-contained inside the 210-char cutoff.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: The sitting governor's active hyperscaler pitch; correction names a concrete capital consequence (cooling is the 5% line; delivered power, among the highest in the US, is the dominant unresolved cost absent Alaska LNG close or a renewable build). Minus one: consequence named in aggregate, not a specific deal/developer.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: Concedes the physics, cites Nordic hyperscalers (Iceland, Finland, Sweden), grants the 30-degree differential, credits PUE math as real. No snark; matches dossier steelman.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: Both rebuttal facts are UAF ACEP primary sources in the dossier (5% or less of O&M; electricity among highest in US).

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Specifics in almost every sentence; only the prescriptive closing paragraph is lighter.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Three independently-originating asserters and two primary ACEP counter-sources, all in dossier, named inline with outlets and dates.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, position-taking; matches post_001.md. Minus one for being shorter/less layered than the anchor.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 2-4 sentence paragraphs, one 3-item bullet block, in word and char range, clean mobile scan.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Specific, debatable, tied to the corrected power-vs-cooling frame; no softener or CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Reader leaves with a clear reframe (resolve power price before anchoring on cooling). Minus one: no benchmark number supplied.

hard_fail_checks.name: punctuation_bans_held
hard_fail_checks.detail: No em/en-dashes, double-hyphens, colons, or semicolons in body; only single hyphens in compounds.

hard_fail_checks.name: total_char_count_under_linkedin_cap
hard_fail_checks.detail: 2603 characters total including hashtag line, under the 3000 cap.

hard_fail_checks.name: claim_is_attributed
hard_fail_checks.detail: Governor Mike Dunleavy named, claim quoted as it circulates, traces to dossier asserters; Berkowitz and Tozzi also named.

hard_fail_checks.detail: Genuine steelman paragraph before any rebuttal, consistent with dossier.
